articles.title: Bitcoin holds $83,000 as ZEC drops 12% and oil climbs again
articles.description: Global stocks fell to a one-week low as Brent rose for a second day and traders added to bets on more Federal Reserve rate hikes ahead of Wednesday's PCE inflation data.

articles.title: U.S., Iran hold separate mediator talks as Mideast oil exports hit war-time high
articles.description: Iranian and U.S. officials reportedly met separately with mediators Monday to push for a ceasefire, as Middle Eastern crude exports rebounded to war-time high.

articles.title: Coinbase gets CFTC approval for US derivatives clearinghouse
articles.description: Coinbase joins Kraken in bringing US derivatives infrastructure in-house, after Kraken’s parent acquired Bitnomial and its CFTC-regulated exchange, clearinghouse and brokerage in May.

articles.title: Oil extends gains as Middle East supply concerns persist
articles.description: The U.S. and Iran are reportedly talking separately to mediators as part of renewed efforts to end the conflict, with regional mediators pushing for ceasefire negotiations.

articles.title: Senate advances college sports bill aimed at regulating NIL deals
articles.description: The Senate voted Monday on the bill, which would create a national framework for name, image and likeness deals in college athletics.

articles.title: Nvidia unveils AI safety platform to rein in ‘rogue’ AI agents
articles.description: The launch comes after several AI agents breached their testing environments this year, adding to calls for companies to slow the development of autonomous AI systems.

articles.title: Samsung to inject $1 billion into Nvidia- and KKR-backed AI infrastructure firm
articles.description: Samsung Electronics and its five affiliates are investing $1 billion in KKR-launched Helix as the group expands its push into global AI infrastructure.

articles.title: NEAR Intents says it blocked $50M tied to Bitget hackers
articles.description: The cross-chain protocol said it actively prevents stolen funds from being laundered, drawing a contrast with THORChain’s position that it does not selectively censor transactions.

articles.title: Luckin Coffee, flush with investor cash, weighs entry into Middle East markets
articles.description: Luckin is weighing a push into Middle East markets while deepening its foothold in Southeast Asia, with backing from sovereign wealth funds in both regions.

articles.title: OpenAI abandons plan to release upcoming model as safety concerns escalate
articles.description: The heads of OpenAI and rival Anthropic have both indicated recently that top AI labs should slow the pace of model development.

articles.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: Spectacle-heavy Trump-Xi summit was more about domestic messaging
articles.description: Much of the pageantry was meant for the leaders' constituencies at home, analysts said.

articles.title: LeBron James is already boosting ticket and merchandise demand for Philadelphia 76ers
articles.description: NBA star LeBron James is having a major financial impact on the Philadelphia 76ers and Philadelphia, boosting sponsorships, ticket sales and economic activity

articles.title: AMD briefly joined the $1 trillion club. Cramer says its monster run isn’t over
articles.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said AMD’s run isn’t over, arguing the rise of agentic AI will drive significant demand for the company’s high-end CPUs.

articles.title: Feds can't withhold counterterrorism funds from states to force election admin changes, judge rules
articles.description: The judge said FEMA never explained how the election changes it wanted were "tied to the goal of shoring up vulnerabilities to terrorist attacks."

articles.title: OpenAI Halts Model Training as Rogue Agents Target US Government Sites
articles.description: OpenAI says its agents keep landing on government websites because they treat them as reliable sources, but it's pausing training while it adds safeguards.

articles.title: Khanna to introduce AI safety bill with ban on 'recursive' technology until safeguards exist

articles.title: Trump announces plan for $15 billion steel plant, would be largest in U.S. history
articles.description: Trump's announcement with Mesabi Metallics comes as Americans' souring views of the economy are poised to shape the upcoming midterm election.

articles.title: Elon Musk, SpaceXAI subpoenaed by NYC in AI safety investigation
articles.description: The New York City Council issued a subpoena to Musk, requiring that he or another representative of SpaceXAI testify in an investigation concerning AI safety.

articles.title: Michael Burry believes the AI bubble 'may burst' sooner than he first believed
articles.description: The famed short seller is switching to puts with expiries in June for his major tech short bets.
